actual.descripcion: Police chase a stolen Renault that refuses to pull over until the driver crashes. A strip search reveals Class A drugs, police bust a large-scale cannabis farm, and a man forgets to pay his gas bill.

siguiente.descripcion: Police pursue a smoking Audi A3 that fails to stop, before the wannabe Mario hurls cans of oil at the cops. And a suspected drink driver literally gatecrashes a holiday park.

Police interceptors pursue a drunk driver who's suspected to be armed with a knife. A cross-county biker gang pays Nottingham a visit. Around 27 motorbikes and quads cause absolute mayhem on the street.

When Coups and the team get behind a high-performance Mercedes, the driver clocks the cops, goes full throttle up the motorway and careers off road. In Mansfield, Phil Broughton goes undercover to find a van man.
There's mayhem when motorway patrollers discover a car on fire and leaking fuel. A broken-down van blocks a slip road, and a four-vehicle pile-up causes chaos on Spaghetti Junction.

On Spaghetti Junction, the entire motorway must be shut down after a high-speed motorbike crash, and the patrollers' worst fears are confirmed when they realise there's an injured man lying in the carriageway.
A 44-tonne freight lorry crashes and capsizes in the middle of the M6, an HGV almost catches fire when its brakes lock on, and a school bus breaks down in a dangerous spot.
